seoTitle: Better Call Saul Test: Which Character Are You? (11 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Better Call Saul test: 11 everyday questions reveal whether you're Jimmy, Kim, Mike, Chuck, Howard, Nacho, Gus or Lalo — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the smooth talker, the professional, or the one who's always ten steps ahead? Answer 11 everyday questions about work, rules and getting ahead, and find out which Better Call Saul character you are.

characters.name: Jimmy McGill / Saul Goodman
characters.title: The Smooth Talker
characters.summary: Charming, quick and always working an angle. You can talk your way out of anything, and you usually do.
description: Like Jimmy, you could talk your way out of anything. He starts out as a small-time con man known as "Slippin' Jimmy."
You work your way up. Jimmy starts in the mailroom at his brother Chuck's law firm, and goes on to become a lawyer.
You make an impression. Jimmy reinvents himself as the flashy lawyer Saul Goodman, and he's very good at what he does.
characters.flaw: You can't resist a shortcut, even when the honest way would work.
characters.signature: A loud suit, a great story and a loophole nobody else spotted.
characters.clashReason: they'd talk you into something before you'd realized what was happening

characters.name: Kim Wexler
characters.title: The Self-Made One
characters.summary: Smart, driven and fiercely independent. You work harder than anyone, and you don't need to be rescued.
description: Like Kim, you've always looked after yourself. She grew up taking care of herself because her mother drank.
You work hard for what you get. Kim is an ambitious lawyer, and she lands the huge Mesa Verde bank as a client.
You've got a wild side. Kim is tempted to bend the rules, and she plots with Jimmy to ruin Howard's reputation.
characters.flaw: You get a thrill from breaking the rules, even when you know better.
characters.signature: A neat stack of files, a late night at the office and a secret wild streak.
characters.clashReason: they'd quietly redo your work, and do it better

characters.name: Mike Ehrmantraut
characters.title: The Professional
characters.summary: Calm, disciplined and no-nonsense. You do the job right, you don't talk much, and you protect your family.
description: Like Mike, you're a professional. He's a former Philadelphia police officer.
You keep it simple. When we first meet Mike, he's working as a parking-lot attendant in Albuquerque.
Family is everything to you. Mike is fiercely protective of his family, and everything he does is for them.
characters.flaw: You keep everyone at arm's length, even the people who care about you.
characters.signature: A straight face, a steady hand and exactly as many words as are needed.
characters.clashReason: they'd give you a long, silent look until you admitted it

characters.name: Chuck McGill
characters.title: The Stickler
characters.summary: Brilliant, principled and very hard to please. You believe in doing things properly, and you expect others to as well.
description: Like Chuck, you do things by the book. He's a respected senior partner at the law firm Hamlin, Hamlin & McGill.
You have strong principles. Chuck believes doing the right thing is the only true road to success.
You find it hard to let go. Chuck never trusts his brother Jimmy, and he works to stop Jimmy's career as a lawyer.
characters.flaw: You judge people by their worst moment, and you never let it go.
characters.signature: A perfect legal brief, a disappointed look and the phone switched off.
characters.clashReason: they'd never let you forget your one big mistake

characters.name: Howard Hamlin
characters.title: The Smooth Operator
characters.summary: Polished, charming and always professional. You keep things friendly, and you always look the part.
description: Like Howard, you always look the part. He's a name partner, and later the managing partner, at Hamlin, Hamlin & McGill.
You keep it friendly. Howard is polished, privileged and charming, even with people who can't stand him.
You take things to heart. Howard blames himself after Chuck's death.
characters.flaw: You care so much about looking good that people don't trust what's underneath.
characters.signature: A perfect suit, a firm handshake and a smile that never slips.
characters.clashReason: they'd stay so polite that you'd want to scream

characters.name: Nacho Varga
characters.title: The One Looking for a Way Out
characters.summary: Smart, careful and always planning ahead. You keep your head down and your options open.
description: Like Nacho, you're smarter than people expect. He starts as Tuco Salamanca's right-hand man.
You plan your escape. Nacho is calculating and ambitious, and he's always looking for a way out of the cartel.
You respect people who do things properly. Nacho admires Mike's professionalism.
characters.flaw: You trust nobody, so you end up carrying everything alone.
characters.signature: A quiet plan, a watchful eye and a bag packed just in case.
characters.clashReason: they'd never tell you what they were really planning

characters.name: Gus Fring
characters.title: The Mastermind
characters.summary: Calm, polite and always ten steps ahead. You're patient, precise and you never show your hand.
description: Like Gus, you hide in plain sight. He owns the fried chicken chain Los Pollos Hermanos, and he's known for his charity work.
You're incredibly patient. Gus is calm and deeply strategic, and he plans everything far in advance.
You think big. Gus secretly builds a huge underground lab beneath an industrial laundry.
characters.flaw: You control everything so tightly that nobody ever sees the real you.
characters.signature: A pressed shirt, a polite smile and a plan nobody else can see.
characters.clashReason: they'd smile politely while quietly planning your downfall

characters.name: Lalo Salamanca
characters.title: The Wild Card
characters.summary: Charming, curious and dangerously unpredictable. You love a good time, and you miss absolutely nothing.
description: Like Lalo, you're impossible to predict. He's Hector Salamanca's nephew, sent from Mexico to run the family business in Albuquerque.
You notice everything. Lalo is intense, suspicious and obsessed with details.
You don't give up. Lalo survives an assassination attempt, then travels to Germany to find proof that Gus has betrayed the cartel.
characters.flaw: You can't leave a mystery alone, even when you should.
characters.signature: A big grin, a friendly question and a look that says you already know.
characters.clashReason: they'd ask you one friendly question too many

questions.text: You're running late for an important appointment. You...

options.text: Talk your way past the front desk with a great story
Call ahead, apologize politely and arrive exactly when you said
Stroll in late, smiling, like it was all part of the plan
Arrive looking perfect, as if nothing went wrong

questions.text: A friend asks you to bend a small rule for them. You...

options.text: Bend it, and enjoy it a little too much
Refuse. Rules exist for a reason
Help, but quietly, and make sure it can't come back on you
Think it through carefully, then do it very well

questions.text: You have a whole Saturday free. You...

options.text: Spend it with family, and keep it simple
Do absolutely nothing, for once, and feel guilty about it
Go for a run, then book dinner somewhere impressive
Stay home, with every gadget switched off

questions.text: Someone insults you at a dinner party. You...

options.text: Smile politely, and remember it for a very long time
Laugh it off graciously, and change the subject
Come back with a joke that wins the whole room
Grin, lean in and ask them to say it again

questions.text: You're given a big project with a tight deadline. You...

options.text: Work late every night until it's perfect
Plan every step in advance, then do it exactly
Find a creative shortcut nobody thought of
Do it properly, and point out everyone else's mistakes

questions.text: A stranger starts asking you a lot of personal questions. You...

options.text: Answer with as few words as possible
Ask them twice as many questions back
Give a polite, perfectly boring answer
Give them a fake name, just for fun

questions.text: You find out a coworker has been lying to you. You...

options.text: Quietly gather proof, then expose them
Confront them, calmly and directly
Act like nothing's wrong, and watch them closely
Keep your head down. You don't want to get caught in the middle

questions.text: You're stuck in a job you hate. You...

options.text: Quietly plan your way out, one careful step at a time
Leave for something better, and never look back
Stick it out. It pays the bills
Put on a smile, and make the best of it

questions.text: You win a big prize. You...

options.text: Celebrate loudly, and buy a round for everyone
Invest it carefully in something long-term
Put it somewhere safe, and tell nobody
Use it to quietly help someone you love

questions.text: You're a lawyer, and your big case is going badly. You...

options.text: Pull an outrageous stunt in court
Out-prepare everyone, and win on the details
Do it by the book, even if it means losing
Invite the other side to a friendly lunch, and settle

questions.text: You're caught between two dangerous bosses who both want your loyalty. You...

options.text: Play both sides, and look for a way out
Smile, stay patient and outlast them both
Make friends with both, and trust neither
Do the job, take the money and ask no questions
